drivers: Three independent binary attributes (count, fill, rotation) must all be resolved; options are a full 2x2x2 crossing so partial solutions still fail
Count decrement and fill distribution-of-three are familiar, easily spotted rules
Rotation requires a progression inference (90°,45° -> upright) not a value seen in rows 1-2, and rotated triangles are visually subtle
Empty cell (0 pentagons) in row 2 can confuse, but 105 s is ample for a systematic solver
